deliberation: Council rigor and Minder metabolism are distinct primitives. Proxy-policy authority spans both, so the terminal decision must require both without conflating advisory assembly disposition with Human Steward authority.
discharged_obligations: Separated the fifteen advisory offices from Executor and Human Steward operational powers.
findings: The gate applies prospectively to one terminal packet.
amendments: Keep proxy authority as the strict intersection of pre-existing authority, scope, and capability.
residual_uncertainty: Constitutional lore does not use the formal label Grand Council for the fifteen.
